# 1MCP Agent Documentation

1MCP is a unified Model Context Protocol runtime that aggregates multiple MCP servers for AI assistants.

- [English documentation](/llms-en.txt): Canonical English routes and the CLI-mode workflow.
- [中文文档](/llms-zh.txt): 中文规范路由和 CLI 模式工作流。
- [Complete reference](/llms-full.txt): A compact cross-locale reference for agents.
